description: This Java class 'DefaultTbServiceInfoProvider' provides system and service information for Thingsboard, including service ID, type, system metrics, and transport services, and constructs ServiceInfo protobuf messages.

classes.name: DefaultTbServiceInfoProvider
classes.description: A Spring component that provides system and service information, including service ID, type, system metrics, and transport services, for Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service info provider, setting service ID, service types, tenant profiles, and system info.

methods.name: setTransports
methods.description: Builds the ServiceInfo protobuf message with transport service names after context is ready.

methods.name: getTransportServices
methods.description: Retrieves all beans of type TbTransportService from the application context.

methods.name: getServiceInfo
methods.description: Returns the current ServiceInfo protobuf message.

methods.name: isMonolith
methods.description: Checks if the service type is 'monolith'.

methods.name: isService
methods.description: Checks if the service type matches a given ServiceType.

methods.name: generateNewServiceInfoWithCurrentSystemInfo
methods.description: Generates and updates the ServiceInfo protobuf message with current system metrics and configuration.

methods.name: setReady
methods.description: Sets the readiness state of the service and returns whether the state changed.

methods.name: getCurrentSystemInfoProto
methods.description: Builds a SystemInfoProto message with current CPU, memory, disk usage, and total system resources.
